description: RAISE Persistent Poverty is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Administrative", published or maintained by U.S. Census Bureau. RAISE Program Persistent Poverty Dataset. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Administrative". It has 6 columns, among them F. APP - CENSUS TRACT Meets Definition?, G. HDC - CENSUS TRACT Meets Definition?	, A. State, B. County, C. Census Tract Name, E. APP - COUNTY Meets Definition?. The portal shows 2023-01-11 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Census Bureau. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
